title: Neighbourhood buildings and play

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Combine homes and small interactions so neighbourhood identity is communicated through both places and people.
strategic_value: Housing, play equipment and residents can make Helsinki neighbourhood imagery feel inhabited.
demonstration: Pale-blue and white buildings occupy the top and right of a gray field; a swing, laundry rack, residents, shrubs and a van fill the lower area.
practical_value: Build a neighbourhood scene from a few architecture and activity elements rather than using all pieces at once.

content_islands.spec: Arrange building fronts, a birch and shrubs across the upper portion.

content_islands.name: Ground-level activity
content_islands.spec: Place swing, laundry rack, people and vehicle below and between the buildings.
